stage: Stage 1 / Month 1 — Prove the Core Concept
goal: Create repeatable tests for whether the QuantForge prototype is becoming more reliable or worse.
done_when: The team can run an evaluation set and score whether changes improve schema adherence, clarification quality, tool usage and criticism quality.

items.text: Create evaluation cases for vague strategies, impossible rules, missing risk, misleading inputs and suspiciously good results
Define scoring criteria: asks right questions, avoids hallucination, uses tools correctly, produces structured output
Add a simple results log format for each evaluation run
Collect failure cases and lessons learned for the future hosted-agent architecture
Build one Month 1 demo flow: idea -> StrategySpec -> agent review -> tool-backed output
Run the evaluation set before/after one prompt or workflow change
Review whether the critic catches weak assumptions and overfit-looking claims
Write the Month 1 conclusion: what works, what fails, what carries into Month 2
